assay: bulk RNA-seq (Salmon/tximport, mm10) of EDL muscle, male mice, n=3 per group (FIG4 A; S4.12.p1; S4.13.p1)
inclusion: Male strNrip1-/- (MCK-Cre) and WT littermates, 8 wk voluntary wheel running vs sedentary from 8 wk of age; EDL from an independent cohort not subjected to additional testing; non-runners (<5 km/night) removed (S2.3.p1; S4.8.p1; S4.12.p1; S4.1.p1)
primary_estimand: Paper's primary transcriptomic estimand is the genotype effect (KO vs WT) within sedentary and within trained EDL (S2.4.p1, FIG4 B/D). For this request the exercise estimand is the training effect (Trained vs Sedentary) within WT, and within KO; the authors computed these Train-Sed|WT and Train-Sed|KO DESeq2 contrasts and deposited them in GEO but report no counts in the text.
planned_contrasts: Train vs Sed within WT (deposited GEO table column 'Train-Sed|WT'; not counted in the text)
Train vs Sed within KO (deposited 'Train-Sed|KO'; not counted in the text)
KO vs WT within Sed (S2.4.p1: 421 up / 288 down)
KO vs WT within Trained (S2.4.p1, FIG4B: 616 up / 506 down)
repeated_measure_unit: none (one EDL sample per mouse; independent groups)
paper_method: DESeq2 v1.44.0 on tximport gene-level counts, pairwise group comparisons (S4.13.p1-p2; GEO data_processing)

paper_threshold.source_locator: S4.13.p2 (FDR <= 0.05 and |FC| >= 1.2); S2.4.p1/FIG4 state FC > 1.2 and FDR < 0.05

paper_results.physiology: 2-way ANOVA: significant training and genotype effects on VO2max, no interaction (S2.3.p1)
